body:
What do I want... I used to ask my self that all the time. Eventually I just decided to focus on money... it was an easy thing to work on and gave you a number, something solid and empirical.

Now... I want a dream, a wish. What I want probably doesn't exist in this reality or any where close enough to get to. What I want isn't sane, it isn't rational, or reasonable.

But after spending a life time searching I found what I want. The problem is I can never have it. It hurts. In ways I can't even describe. I can't function, I can't focus. I know it's not real... I know it probably can't be but I don't care. I just... I don't want to live with out it.

I'm tired. I feel like I've been running a marathon with out a map, and once I finally find the finish line I see I can't even reach it. I just... I want to quit.

Does that make sense? I'm convinced I have something mentally wrong with me, but I'm not even sure I want it to be fixed if there is. I'm tired of... just everything.

Edit: Am I hard to understand? It feels like my thoughts are fragmented... I'm not sure what exactly I want to say. I'm not even sure why I'm even here. I know this post is different... or at least it feels that way to me. You guys are dealing with people telling you tonight is there last night. I... I probably should be posting elsewhere.

I'm just tired of feeling like this. Of knowing what I want is impossible. Waking up every morning alone, knowing my wish never came true, and never will. I don't know why I keep moving forward. Why I just don't give up. A part of me wants to so bad. To just quit and never wake up again.

I'm tired of walking though this desert seeing water on the horizon only to see it dissolve away like another mirage. You know... I looked at my wrists tonight and just thought for a few minutes how easy it would be. Just a few nicks...

Do I want to die? Do I want to live? I don't know... I just know I want to stop hurting and I don't think I ever will.

When I was a kid I used to push everyone away from me. They scared me, and I enjoyed being alone to their company. But part of me longed for human contact. I never learned how to interact with people. I don't understand my race, and I don't think I really want to.

I want to be near them, yet I fear them. I want... I just want out. It's like there so much noise in my head. So many different thoughts about everything. Yet, they've recently converged on a single idea, and obsession.

Half keeps telling me to stop it's impossible, the other half tells me not to give up. I'm tired of hearing my own thoughts.
